title: DSPx Layer-12 closed fixed-family spec and owner-local publication
description: One-token owner-local evidence contract. It grants no AK legality, affected-use publication, policy selection, apply, promotion, activation, dogfood, or rollout authority.

program_intent.name: DirectionController
program_intent.objective: Produce advisory Layer-12 transition IR for deterministic AK verification.

program_intent.name: CloseImplementationWave
program_intent.objective: Produce blocked advisory evidence for closing an implementation wave.

program_intent.name: ActivateGuidance
program_intent.objective: Produce blocked advisory evidence for guidance activation.

program_intent.name: DefaultResidualAdoptionHardening
program_intent.objective: Produce blocked advisory evidence for default residual-adoption hardening.

program_intent.name: InspectStatusBeforeProceeding
program_intent.objective: Inspect supplied execution state and emit read-only evidence without performing a transition.

program_intent.name: OpenDecision
program_intent.objective: Emit blocked owner-local evidence when an explicit current decision authorization is unavailable.

program_intent.name: RecordReviewOutcomeReadiness
program_intent.objective: Emit blocked owner-local readiness evidence for one proposed review outcome without recording it or dispatching a successor.

missing_preconditions: explicit review-outcome mutation authorization for the exact current decision and review attempt

program_intent.name: RecordAdrReadiness
program_intent.objective: Emit blocked owner-local readiness evidence for record_adr while rejecting duplicate ADR recording and performing no mutation.

missing_preconditions: new current decision with ready_for_adr closure and no recorded ADR
explicit ADR mutation authorization for that exact current decision and legal review closure
